noise_policy: Topic -1 is dropped and excluded from the volume denominator.

perspectives.title: Job Displacement
perspectives.summary: People are tracking layoffs and wondering which white-collar roles survive the next model release.

representative_posts.author: maya.bsky
representative_posts.text: Third agency this month replaced their junior writers with an LLM. This is not a vibe, it is a payroll strategy.

representative_posts.author: unionize.dev
representative_posts.text: If your job is 'summarize the meeting', the meeting is already the product. Automating you was the easy part.

representative_posts.author: careershelf
representative_posts.text: Career counselor today told a room of new grads to 'become AI-proof'. Nobody could define what that means.

arguments: White-collar work that is mostly drafting, summarizing, or first-pass analysis is already being treated as a cost center, not a craft.
Telling new graduates to become 'AI-proof' is not a labor market. It is an admission that employers will not invest in juniors.
The threat is not a single AGI event. It is a quiet payroll strategy repeating across agencies and back offices.

perspectives.title: Acceleration Optimism
perspectives.summary: A loud cohort treats faster models as a civilizational upgrade and wants fewer brakes, not more.

representative_posts.author: buildfast
representative_posts.text: The productivity jump from local models this year is real. I shipped in a weekend what used to take a squad.

representative_posts.author: nova.codes
representative_posts.text: We are arguing about feelings while a billion people just got a free research assistant. Scale is the moral story.

representative_posts.author: garage-lab
representative_posts.text: Open weights are the printing press. The panic is the same genre as every other literacy panic.

arguments: A free research assistant for a billion people is a moral story about scale, not just a product launch.
Open weights are a literacy shock. The panic rhymes with every other time a tool escaped the guild.
Shipping in a weekend what used to take a squad is the evidence. Feelings are the lagging indicator.

perspectives.title: Safety Alignment
perspectives.summary: Researchers and bystanders keep returning to loss-of-control, evals, and whether labs will slow down.

representative_posts.author: evalwatch
representative_posts.text: Capability demos dropped. The public eval suite did not. That gap is the actual news.

representative_posts.author: redteam.bsky
representative_posts.text: I do not need sci-fi. I need labs to publish what their models will not refuse next quarter.

representative_posts.author: slowtake
representative_posts.text: Alignment is not a vibe check. If you cannot measure it, you are fundraising, not governing.

arguments: Capability demos without public evals are fundraising, not governance.
If you cannot measure refusal, you do not have alignment. You have a vibe check with a press kit.
The news is the gap between what the model will do next quarter and what anyone is willing to publish.

perspectives.title: Creative Labor
perspectives.summary: Artists and performers frame generative tools as unpaid training on their catalogs.

representative_posts.author: inkstudy
representative_posts.text: My style is in six commercial models and I was never asked. That is not inspiration, that is inventory.

representative_posts.author: session-musician
representative_posts.text: Labels want infinite cheap stems. They still want a human face for the encore. Guess who gets the contract.

representative_posts.author: comicgrid
representative_posts.text: Commission market is weird now. Clients send a generated rough and ask me to 'make it not look generated'.

arguments: A style that shows up in six commercial models without consent is inventory, not inspiration.
Labels and clients still want a human face for the encore while they automate the catalog that paid for it.
'Make this not look generated' is the new commission: unpaid training, then paid cleanup.

perspectives.title: Energy Footprint
perspectives.summary: The cluster boom is being read as a climate and utilities story, not just a software story.

representative_posts.author: gridnotes
representative_posts.text: Our town's next substation is sized for a training campus, not households. That should be a public meeting.

representative_posts.author: hydro.watch
representative_posts.text: Water-cooled racks in a drought basin is the kind of sentence that used to live in a dystopian novel.

representative_posts.author: wattmeter
representative_posts.text: I want the model card to include megawatts. Tokens are not a unit of accountability.

arguments: The next substation in town is being sized for a training campus, not households, and that is a public meeting.
Tokens are not a unit of accountability. Megawatts and water are.
Water-cooled racks in a drought basin make AI a utilities story before it is a software story.

perspectives.title: Everyday Copilots
perspectives.summary: The quieter majority is just using assistants for mail, homework, and small workarounds.

representative_posts.author: tuesday.admin
representative_posts.text: I do not care about AGI. I care that it drafted the insurance appeal I had been avoiding for six weeks.

representative_posts.author: dad-of-three
representative_posts.text: Helped my kid outline a history essay. The useful part was the questions, not the paragraphs.

representative_posts.author: clinic.front
representative_posts.text: We use it to translate after-visit notes. Imperfect, but the alternative was sending people home confused.

arguments: Most people are not arguing about AGI. They are using a draft to finish the insurance appeal they had been avoiding.
The useful part of homework help is the questions, not the paragraphs.
Imperfect translation of after-visit notes still beats sending someone home confused.

perspectives.title: Rent Burden
perspectives.summary: A dominant thread treats rent as the organizing fact of adult life, crowding out every other plan.

representative_posts.author: leasehold
representative_posts.text: Half my take-home is a one-bedroom that failed inspection twice. The market is not a weather system.

representative_posts.author: roomate-math
representative_posts.text: I have a graduate degree and three roommates. That sentence should not still be true at 34.

representative_posts.author: citybus
representative_posts.text: Moved an hour out to afford a studio. My 'housing win' is a 2am last-train lifestyle.

arguments: When half of take-home pay is a one-bedroom that failed inspection, the market is a policy, not weather.
A graduate degree and three roommates at 34 is not a lifestyle. It is a rationing system with a lease.
Moving an hour out to afford a studio just converts rent into a last-train lifestyle.

perspectives.title: Zoning Reform
perspectives.summary: YIMBY arguments keep pointing at parking minimums, single-family maps, and hearing-room vetoes.

representative_posts.author: missingmiddle
representative_posts.text: We legalized duplexes and then spent a year inventing new ways to make them illegal in practice.

representative_posts.author: transit.maps
representative_posts.text: If a train stop is surrounded by lawns, that is a policy choice, not a housing shortage mystery.

representative_posts.author: council-notes
representative_posts.text: Same ten homeowners show up, same 'neighborhood character' line, same empty lots. Character is a zoning code.

arguments: Legalizing duplexes and then inventing new ways to ban them is how shortage becomes a local brand.
A train stop surrounded by lawns is a choice encoded in parking minimums and hearing-room vetoes.
'Neighborhood character' is doing the work of a zoning code that keeps lots empty on purpose.

perspectives.title: Homeownership Gap
perspectives.summary: Younger buyers describe down payments and insurance as a locked door, not a ladder.

representative_posts.author: firststair
representative_posts.text: Saved for five years. Insurance quotes ate the entire buffer in one renewal cycle.

representative_posts.author: ratewatch
representative_posts.text: My parents bought on one income. I cannot get a preapproval with two and a side gig.

representative_posts.author: creditdust
representative_posts.text: Starter homes are investment products now. Families are bidding against someone's portfolio allocation.

arguments: Down payments and insurance quotes are a locked door, not a delayed ladder.
Two incomes and a side gig still cannot match the preapproval one income used to buy.
Starter homes are investment products. Families are bidding against someone's portfolio allocation.

perspectives.title: Investor Landlords
perspectives.summary: Corporate owners and short-term rentals are blamed for turning shelter into a yield strategy.

representative_posts.author: blockwatch
representative_posts.text: Twelve units on my street went to an LLC last year. None of those doors have names on the buzzer anymore.

representative_posts.author: host-fatigue
representative_posts.text: The building is half Airbnbs. We live in a hallway of suitcases and key-lock boxes.

representative_posts.author: maintenance-q
representative_posts.text: Filed the same leak with a chatbot portal for 40 days. Private equity does not own a plunger.

arguments: When twelve units on a street go to an LLC, shelter has been converted into a yield strategy.
A hallway of key-lock boxes is not a neighborhood. It is short-term rental infrastructure.
A chatbot portal cannot own a plunger. Private equity is allergic to maintenance that does not hit a dashboard.

perspectives.title: Asylum Backlog
perspectives.summary: Case workers and migrants describe a queue so long it functions as a policy by itself.

representative_posts.author: docket-404
representative_posts.text: A hearing date in 2029 is not due process. It is a waiting room with no chairs.

representative_posts.author: shelter-night
representative_posts.text: We ran out of mats before we ran out of families. The backlog has an address this week.

representative_posts.author: form-i
representative_posts.text: Lost my work permit in a processing hole. I can stay. I cannot legally earn. That is the trap.

arguments: A hearing date in 2029 is a waiting room with no chairs, not due process.
Running out of mats before families is the backlog with an address.
Allowed to stay and forbidden to earn is a trap built out of processing holes.

perspectives.title: Labor Shortage
perspectives.summary: Farms, kitchens, and care homes keep asking where legal workers are supposed to come from.

representative_posts.author: orchard-am
representative_posts.text: Fruit does not wait for a visa category. Either we pick it or we import it already picked.

representative_posts.author: kitchen-lead
representative_posts.text: I can raise wages. I cannot summon a line cook from a closed legal channel.

representative_posts.author: home-care
representative_posts.text: Aging towns need hands. The debate is happening as if the patients can postpone.

arguments: Fruit does not wait for a visa category. You pick it or you import it already picked.
Raising kitchen wages cannot summon a line cook from a closed legal channel.
Aging towns need hands now. Patients cannot postpone while the debate finds a slogan.

perspectives.title: Surveillance Ads
perspectives.summary: People are tired of feeling followed from a search to a couch to a billboard.

representative_posts.author: ad-shadow
representative_posts.text: I mentioned a crib once in a voice note. The feed already had a registry. That is not coincidence, that is a dossier.

representative_posts.author: opt-out-maze
representative_posts.text: The privacy dashboard has 40 toggles and one business model. Guess which one wins.

representative_posts.author: bus-stop-ad
representative_posts.text: When the billboard knows my cart, public space is just another slot.

arguments: Mention a crib once and the feed grows a registry. That is a dossier, not a coincidence.
A privacy dashboard with 40 toggles and one business model is not a choice.
When the billboard knows the cart, public space is just another ad slot.

perspectives.title: Data Brokers
perspectives.summary: Broker files, people-search sites, and leaked location history keep showing up as a hidden market.

representative_posts.author: delete-me
representative_posts.text: I paid a service to remove me from 80 sites. 12 came back in a month. Whack-a-mole is not a right.

representative_posts.author: loc-leak
representative_posts.text: A broker sold 'sensitive location' pings. The category name is already a confession.

representative_posts.author: skiptrace
representative_posts.text: My home address is a product. I did not list it. Someone else made a SKU.

arguments: Paying to be deleted from 80 sites that come back in a month is not a right. It is whack-a-mole.
Selling 'sensitive location' pings is a confession in the category name.
A home address that became a SKU without being listed is a hidden market, not a public record.

perspectives.title: Device Lock-in
perspectives.summary: Repair, sideloading, and account gates are framed as ownership that expires at the login screen.

representative_posts.author: right-to-fix
representative_posts.text: A $1,200 phone that refuses a $20 battery is a rental with extra steps.

representative_posts.author: sideload
representative_posts.text: If I cannot install software I trust, I do not own a computer. I own a showroom.

representative_posts.author: cloud-key
representative_posts.text: Lost the account, lost the photos, lost the documents. The hardware is a paperweight with a camera.

arguments: A phone that refuses a $20 battery is a rental with extra steps.
If you cannot install software you trust, you own a showroom, not a computer.
Lose the account and the hardware is a paperweight. Ownership that expires at login is the product.

perspectives.title: Encryption Rights
perspectives.summary: Security folks treat client-side scanning and backdoor bills as the same old key-escrow fight.

representative_posts.author: signal-fan
representative_posts.text: A backdoor for the good guys is a front door for everyone else. Math does not do nationalities.

representative_posts.author: threat-model
representative_posts.text: Journalists, clinics, and shelters need the same cryptography as hobbyists. That is the point.

representative_posts.author: csam-scan
representative_posts.text: Scan-on-device is still a surveillance architecture. Rename it as many times as you want.

arguments: A backdoor for the good guys is a front door for everyone else. Math does not do nationalities.
Journalists, clinics, and shelters need the same cryptography as hobbyists. That is the point.
Scan-on-device is still a surveillance architecture no matter how many times it is renamed.

perspectives.title: Kids Online
perspectives.summary: Parents want defaults that assume a child, not another terms-of-service checkbox.

representative_posts.author: parent-mode
representative_posts.text: The app is free because my 12-year-old is the inventory. I would like that sentence in the onboarding.

representative_posts.author: school-tablet
representative_posts.text: District issued devices, district issued trackers. Homework should not be a telemetry event.

representative_posts.author: age-gate
representative_posts.text: A checkbox that says I am 18 is not a child-safety program. It is a liability fig leaf.

arguments: The app is free because a 12-year-old is the inventory. That sentence belongs in onboarding.
District-issued devices that are also trackers make homework a telemetry event.
A checkbox that says 'I am 18' is a liability fig leaf, not a child-safety program.

perspectives.title: Open Source Hope
perspectives.summary: A hopeful minority still treats local software and audits as an exit from the attention market.

representative_posts.author: self-host
representative_posts.text: Moved photos off the big cloud. I am now the unreliable vendor, but at least I am not the product.

representative_posts.author: foss-friday
representative_posts.text: The boring tools are the freedom tools. Nobody influencers a calendar you can grep.

representative_posts.author: local-llm
representative_posts.text: A model on my desk cannot quietly update its privacy policy at 3am. That is a feature.

arguments: Moving photos off the big cloud makes you the unreliable vendor, but at least you are not the product.
The boring tools are the freedom tools. Nobody influencers a calendar you can grep.
A model on the desk cannot quietly update its privacy policy at 3am. That is a feature.

perspectives.title: Extreme Weather
perspectives.summary: Lived experience of heat, flood, and fire is doing more persuading than any report abstract.

representative_posts.author: smoke-season
representative_posts.text: We canceled recess again. Kids can identify AQI colors before they can identify state birds.

representative_posts.author: river-row
representative_posts.text: Third flood in five years. FEMA is a form, not a plan, and my street knows the difference.

representative_posts.author: night-heat
representative_posts.text: The power stayed on. The nights did not cool. That is the new definition of a lucky summer.

arguments: Kids who can identify AQI colors before state birds are living the report, not reading it.
A third flood in five years makes FEMA a form, not a plan.
Nights that do not cool are the new definition of a lucky summer, and that is doing more persuading than any abstract.

perspectives.title: Adaptation Funding
perspectives.summary: Local officials want money for shade, pumps, and grids rather than another target-year slogan.

representative_posts.author: city-budget
representative_posts.text: I can pass a net-zero resolution in an afternoon. A cooling center takes a line item and a fight.

representative_posts.author: coastal-eng
representative_posts.text: Retreat is a planning word. On the ground it is buyouts, arguments, and people who will not leave.

representative_posts.author: mutual-aid
representative_posts.text: When the county map is late, neighbors become infrastructure. That should embarrass someone paid.

arguments: A net-zero resolution is an afternoon. A cooling center is a line item and a fight.
Retreat is a planning word. On the ground it is buyouts, arguments, and people who will not leave.
When the county map is late, neighbors become infrastructure, and that should embarrass someone paid.

perspectives.title: Fossil Phaseout
perspectives.summary: Campaigners keep pressure on permits, banks, and the remaining expansion projects.

representative_posts.author: keep-it-down
representative_posts.text: A new terminal is not a transition. It is a 40-year bet that the math is optional.

representative_posts.author: divest-now
representative_posts.text: If your pension still underwrites the expansion, the postcard from the beach is paid for twice.

representative_posts.author: permian-watch
representative_posts.text: Flaring at night looks like a city. It is not a city. It is wasted gas and a permission structure.

arguments: A new terminal is a 40-year bet that the math is optional, not a transition.
If the pension still underwrites expansion, the beach postcard is paid for twice.
Flaring that looks like a city at night is wasted gas plus a permission structure.

perspectives.title: Wage Stagnation
perspectives.summary: Workers keep stacking raises against rent and groceries and calling the remainder a disappearance.

representative_posts.author: paycheck-math
representative_posts.text: 4% raise, 9% everything else. HR called it a strong year. My cart disagreed.

representative_posts.author: tipped-out
representative_posts.text: We are 'essential' on the window cling and optional on the schedule. Pick one.

representative_posts.author: salary-band
representative_posts.text: Posted range starts below last year's median. The ghost job is a negotiating tactic.

arguments: A 4% raise against 9% everything else is a strong year only in the HR deck.
Essential on the window cling and optional on the schedule is not a wage. It is a slogan.
Posted ranges that start below last year's median are a negotiating tactic dressed as a job.

perspectives.title: Union Revival
perspectives.summary: New organizing drives treat a card campaign as the only remaining leverage.

representative_posts.author: card-check
representative_posts.text: We won the vote. Then the bargaining calendar became the new battlefield. Expected, still exhausting.

representative_posts.author: warehouse-a2
representative_posts.text: They flew in the consultants the day after we asked for water and a fan. Subtle.

representative_posts.author: grad-worker
representative_posts.text: If the university can find money for a stadium, it can find money for the people grading the exams.

arguments: Winning the vote just moves the battlefield onto the bargaining calendar.
Flying in consultants the day after a water-and-fan ask is the tell.
A stadium budget and an empty grader payroll is the university's real priorities list.

perspectives.title: Gig Precarity
perspectives.summary: App-based work is described as flexibility with the safety rails removed.

representative_posts.author: last-mile
representative_posts.text: I am a contractor until the algorithm wants a uniform. Then I am a brand.

representative_posts.author: rideshare-am
representative_posts.text: Quest bonus vanished, insurance did not. Flexibility is a slogan that does not jump a dead battery.

representative_posts.author: shopper-notes
representative_posts.text: Customer tips on vibes. The app tips on silence. Neither is a wage.

arguments: Contractor until the algorithm wants a uniform is flexibility with the safety rails removed.
Quest bonuses vanish. Insurance does not. Dead batteries do not care about the slogan.
Tips on vibes and silence are not a wage, no matter what the app calls them.

perspectives.title: Return To Office
perspectives.summary: Badge-in mandates remain a trust fight between managers and people who rebuilt their lives around remote.

representative_posts.author: badge-swipe
representative_posts.text: Three days in for meetings that are still on Zoom because half the team is in another tower.

representative_posts.author: manager-view
representative_posts.text: I do not miss surveillance. I miss the hallway corrections that never become a ticket.

representative_posts.author: commute-tax
representative_posts.text: Office policy is a pay cut that does not appear on the offer letter.

arguments: Three badge-in days for meetings that are still on Zoom is a trust fight, not a collaboration plan.
The commute is a pay cut that does not appear on the offer letter.
Hallway corrections are real. Surveillance is not the same thing as presence.

perspectives.title: Access Barriers
perspectives.summary: Wait times, closed panels, and geography still dominate how people talk about getting care.

representative_posts.author: hold-music
representative_posts.text: Six months for a primary care intake. That is not a system, that is a lottery with copays.

representative_posts.author: night-shift-rn
representative_posts.text: We are not short on compassion. We are short on beds, nurses, and anyone who can stay past year three.

representative_posts.author: no-panel
representative_posts.text: Insurance card in hand. Every nearby clinic: not accepting new patients. The card is a brochure.

arguments: Six months for a primary-care intake is a lottery with copays, not a system.
An insurance card that every nearby clinic will not honor is a brochure.
The shortage is beds, nurses, and anyone who can stay past year three — not compassion.

perspectives.title: Drug Pricing
perspectives.summary: Insulin, inhalers, and new weight-loss drugs keep collapsing the conversation into list prices.

representative_posts.author: rx-stub
representative_posts.text: The coupon expired, the price tripled, the molecule did not change. Explain that without using the word 'market'.

representative_posts.author: pharmacy-tech
representative_posts.text: I spend half my day calling around for a fill people already paid insurance to theoretically have.

representative_posts.author: glp1-wait
representative_posts.text: A shortage of a celebrity drug should not crowd out thyroid meds. Priorities are a choice.

arguments: A coupon that expires while the molecule stays the same is not a market. It is a trapdoor.
Pharmacy techs spending half the day hunting fills people already paid to theoretically have is the real clinical time.
A celebrity-drug shortage crowding out thyroid meds is a priority, not an accident.

perspectives.title: Mental Health
perspectives.summary: Therapy access, youth distress, and burnout remain a parallel system people assemble themselves.

representative_posts.author: waitlist
representative_posts.text: The hotline was kind. The intake was 14 weeks. Kindness is not capacity.

representative_posts.author: school-couns
representative_posts.text: I have 700 students and a closet office. That is the youth mental health plan in one sentence.

representative_posts.author: shift-end
representative_posts.text: We told everyone to destigmatize therapy and then made it a luxury good. Bold strategy.

arguments: A kind hotline and a 14-week intake is kindness without capacity.
Seven hundred students and a closet office is the youth mental-health plan in one sentence.
Destigmatizing therapy and then pricing it as a luxury good is a strategy with a punchline.

perspectives.title: Insurance Maze
perspectives.summary: Prior auth, networks, and denied claims are treated as the real clinical bottleneck.

representative_posts.author: denied-again
representative_posts.text: The scan is medically necessary until a person who has never met me decides it is educational.

representative_posts.author: billing-dept
representative_posts.text: I am a nurse who now speaks 'appeals'. That is not why I sat for the boards.

representative_posts.author: in-network
representative_posts.text: The surgeon was in-network. The anesthesiologist was a surprise. This country loves plot twists.

arguments: Prior auth is the actual clinical bottleneck: a stranger deciding the scan is educational.
Nurses who now speak 'appeals' did not sit for the boards to become billing clerks.
In-network surgeons with surprise anesthesiologists are a plot twist this country refuses to write out of the contract.

perspectives.title: Rural Hospitals
perspectives.summary: Closures and long ambulance rides make care a distance problem before it is a science problem.

representative_posts.author: county-er
representative_posts.text: Labor and delivery is 90 minutes away. That is a policy outcome with a county name on it.

representative_posts.author: volunteer-emt
representative_posts.text: We lost the hospital and kept the highway. Guess which one people still need at 2am.

representative_posts.author: clinic-tues
representative_posts.text: Specialists fly in twice a month. Chronic illness does not keep that calendar.

arguments: Labor and delivery 90 minutes away is a policy outcome with a county name on it.
Keeping the highway after losing the hospital is how 2am becomes a distance problem first.
Specialists who fly in twice a month cannot keep a chronic-illness calendar.

perspectives.title: Sequel Glut
perspectives.summary: Viewers treat the calendar as a photocopy machine: another number in the title, another weekend of déjà vu.
arguments: A sequel that exists to keep a slot warm is not a story. It is a timeshare.
When every original is a pilot for a universe, nobody is serving the two hours you paid for.
Fatigue is a market signal. Studios keep reading it as a branding problem.

representative_posts.author: part-seven
representative_posts.text: I do not hate the characters. I hate that they will never be allowed to end.

representative_posts.author: slot-warm
representative_posts.text: The date was booked before the script. You can feel it in act two.

representative_posts.author: universe-tax
representative_posts.text: I bought a ticket to a movie and got homework for a slide deck.

perspectives.title: Ticket Prices
perspectives.summary: Families describe a night out as a luxury SKU: dynamic seating, $9 water, and a film that will be home in 45 days.
arguments: If the window is six weeks, the premium has to be the room, not the file.
Dynamic pricing at a multiplex is how you train people to wait for the couch.
A kid's birthday at the movies should not require a payment plan.

representative_posts.author: 9-water
representative_posts.text: The movie was fine. The concession was a second mortgage. I paused the habit.

representative_posts.author: 45-days
representative_posts.text: Why is opening weekend a tax if the file is already on the truck to my TV.

representative_posts.author: birthday
representative_posts.text: Four kids, one PG, one regret. We do the backyard now.

perspectives.title: Originals
perspectives.summary: A stubborn cluster still wants a new world, a new face, and a studio that can live with a single movie.
arguments: Originals need a budget that is not an apology and a weekend that is not a punishment.
Mid-budget adult films did not die of taste. They died of a spreadsheet that only speaks franchise.
If the algorithm only greenlights awareness, awareness is all you will get.

representative_posts.author: mid-budget
representative_posts.text: Give me $40 million and a novelist. Keep the cameo from 2012.

representative_posts.author: punish-weekend
representative_posts.text: They dumped the original in October against a sequel and called it data.

representative_posts.author: new-face
representative_posts.text: I do not need a universe. I need a person I have not met and two hours.

perspectives.title: IP Law
perspectives.summary: This view is the mouse and the estate: copyright terms that keep a century of work in a vault.
arguments: A term that outlives the grandchildren is not an incentive for the artist. It is a portfolio for the firm.
Fan works that get a takedown while the studio sleeps on a sequel is a weird allocation of vigor.
Public domain is how culture compounds. Forever-minus-a-day is how it calcifies.

representative_posts.author: vault
representative_posts.text: The estate is 'exploring options'. The options are a candle and a lawsuit.

representative_posts.author: fan-edit
representative_posts.text: I made a trailer. They made a lawyer. The sequel is still vapor.

representative_posts.author: compound
representative_posts.text: Let the mouse go. We have new stories if you stop sitting on the old ones.

perspectives.title: App Bans
perspectives.summary: This cluster treats storefront removals and national bans as political weapons that users cannot appeal, not as safety hygiene.
arguments: When a government or a storefront can zero an app overnight, speech and livelihood sit behind a terms-of-service cop.
Safety claims that never come with a public evidence room are just a takedown with better lighting.
A ban that leaves the same content on a dozen clones is theater. It trains people to expect disappearance, not due process.

representative_posts.author: sideload-mom
representative_posts.text: They banned the app my cousin uses to call home and left the clones. That is not safety. That is a press conference.

representative_posts.author: dev-gone
representative_posts.text: My game vanished on a Friday with a template email. Support is a form that thanks me for my patience.

representative_posts.author: shop-cop
representative_posts.text: If the store can unperson a newsroom, it is a regulator. Bill it like one.

perspectives.title: Store Fees
perspectives.summary: Developers argue that 15–30% plus mandatory billing is a tax on software, extracted because the door is the product.
arguments: A toll on every subscription is not 'keeping the ecosystem safe'. It is rent on the only door users are allowed to use.
Small studios pay the same cut as mega-publishers and eat it in slow death, not in a keynote.
If sideloading and competing billing are dangerous, the danger is competition.

representative_posts.author: indie-sub
representative_posts.text: Thirty percent of a $4 membership is my rent. Apple did not write the levels.

Without public money, the market rations care to people who already have a grandmother or a trust.

Medicaid rates that cannot clear gas and time will keep producing a shortage and a speech about dignity.
The family still does the night shift. The agency does the invoice.

representative_posts.text: We leave at 6. The daughter takes over at 6:01. That is the real staffing model.

perspectives.title: Unpaid Hours
perspectives.summary: This cluster names the granddaughter, the spouse, and the neighbor as the largest care workforce — off the books on purpose.

A 'sandwich generation' is a policy failure with a cute name.
Leave that is job-protected but unpaid is a right only people with savings can use.

representative_posts.author: sandwich
representative_posts.text: I am HR, a daughter, and a mother before 9am. None of that is in the employment report.

representative_posts.author: fmla-zero

representative_posts.author: neighbor-meds

perspectives.summary: Advocates want a public floor — universal pre-K that lasts past 2pm, home-care benefits, and a wage that is not a tip jar.
arguments: A market that cannot price infant care without burning out the worker is asking the state to be the employer of last resort. Fine.
Tax credits that assume a spare $12,000 are a gift to people who already found a slot.
If care is infrastructure, build it like a road: public, boring, and open at hours people work.

representative_posts.author: pre-k-2pm
representative_posts.text: Universal until 2pm is a press conference. I work until 5. Hire the afternoon or stop saying universal.

representative_posts.author: credit-gap

representative_posts.author: public-aide
representative_posts.text: Put home care on a public payroll with a pension. The 'market' already told us the price.

perspectives.title: Sensor Streets
perspectives.summary: Residents argue that cameras, mics, and plate readers turned the block into a product, with a vendor dashboard for a city hall.
arguments: A pole that hears gunshots and also stores faces is not a public safety tool until the retention policy is a law.
Consent is a joke when the alternative is not using the sidewalk.
If the feed can be subpoenaed, sold, or breached, it is a public records problem wearing an LED.

representative_posts.author: pole-cam
representative_posts.text: There are four cameras on my corner and no bus shelter. That is a budget with a lens.

representative_posts.author: shotspotter
representative_posts.text: The mic is sure. The cops are late. We bought a siren, not a solution.

representative_posts.author: plate-lot
representative_posts.text: They know I was at the clinic. The city calls it traffic. I call it a file.

perspectives.title: Vendor Lock-in
perspectives.summary: Procurement people describe 'smart' as a 15-year contract that outlives the mayor and the API.
arguments: A city that cannot export its own traffic data does not own a system. It is renting a mayor's dashboard.
Closed protocols on streetlights are how a lighting bid becomes a surveillance monopoly.
If the only people who can change a timing plan work for the vendor, democracy has an SLA.

representative_posts.author: api-wall
representative_posts.text: We asked for the data. They offered a PDF. That is not a partner. That is a hostage-taker with a logo.

representative_posts.author: light-bus
representative_posts.text: The bulbs are fine. The software lease is the streetlight now.

representative_posts.author: rfp-ghost
representative_posts.text: Nobody else bid because the spec was written in the incumbent's dialect. Cute.

perspectives.title: Traffic AI
perspectives.summary: This cluster wants signals that actually move buses and ambulances, and is tired of a 'digital twin' that cannot fix a left turn.
arguments: Optimization that does not count people on the bus is just speeding up cars.
A model trained on last year's congestion will freeze a bad geometry in place and call it intelligence.
Give the emergency preemption and the bus a real priority. The rest is a demo day.

representative_posts.author: bus-red
representative_posts.text: The 'smart' corridor made the car two minutes faster and the bus four minutes slower. Check the weights.

representative_posts.author: twin-town
representative_posts.text: They showed a 3D model of the intersection. The left-turn arrow is still a myth at 5pm.

representative_posts.author: emt-preempt
representative_posts.text: If the software cannot see a siren, it is not AI. It is a timer with a press kit.

perspectives.title: Public Records
perspectives.summary: Journalists and residents want the logs, contracts, and retention schedules — the unsexy half of a camera network.
arguments: A smart city that cannot answer a FOIA is not modern. It is a black box with a tourism video.
Retention is the policy. Without it, every sensor is a forever archive waiting for a later use.
Publish the contracts. If the clause says the vendor owns the footage, the city sold the sidewalk.

representative_posts.author: foia-delay
representative_posts.text: I asked for the retention schedule. They sent a marketing one-pager. That is the tell.

representative_posts.author: forever-clip
representative_posts.text: There is no deletion date in the contract. So there is no deletion date on my kid's walk to school.

representative_posts.author: vendor-owns
representative_posts.text: Clause 14: footage is the contractor's IP. We are the set. They are the studio.

perspectives.title: NIL
perspectives.summary: The name-image-likeness era as a labor market that still pretends to be a bake sale.
arguments: If a booster can buy a quarterback, the amateur is a costume.
NIL that only works for a few sports is a Title IX test the brochure is not ready for.
A right to your face is not a scandal. The scandal was the years without it.

representative_posts.author: costume
representative_posts.text: He has an LLC and a playbook. Call him a worker. The rest is a reunion speech.

representative_posts.author: few-sports
representative_posts.text: The volleyball roster noticed the football collective. So will a lawyer.

representative_posts.author: years-without
representative_posts.text: We were the product. We got a meal plan. I can do that math in public now.

perspectives.summary: The portal as free agency with a GPA — and a roster that is a year-to-year startup.

If the roster is a portal, development is a speech. Say that to the kid on the bench.
Collectives that recruit in the portal are GMs. Put them on the masthead.

perspectives.summary: Realignment as a TV map: geography is optional, the logo on the Saturday window is not.
arguments: A conference that spans three time zones is not a league. It is a cable package.
Student-athletes who fly red-eyes for a Thursday game are the cost of the package.
Rivalries that die for a bid are how you teach a region it was always content.

perspectives.title: Academics
perspectives.summary: A quieter cluster still wants the degree to be a degree — clustering, eligibility, and a major that cannot travel.
arguments: A major that exists to keep a body eligible is not a university. It is a visa.
If the travel calendar cannot coexist with a lab, the lab loses, and we should stop lying about it.
Graduation rates that hide clusters are a branding exercise.

De-escalation is a skill and a staffing number. A memo without training hours is a poster.

perspectives.summary: Advocates want footage that actually reaches the public: unedited, timely, and not a FOIA obstacle course.

perspectives.summary: Critics read buybacks as the corporate purpose: juice the per-share number, starve the shop floor, call it returning capital.
arguments: A firm that borrows to shrink its share count is not investing. It is financial engineering with a press release.

Executives paid in stock have a hobby. It rhymes with repurchase.

perspectives.summary: This view is still 2008 in muscle memory: capital, liquidity, and the quiet dump of the uninsured when a mid-size name wobbles.
arguments: Deregulation that shows up as a weekend sale is not efficiency. It is a put the public did not price.
Living wills nobody believes are literature. Loss-absorbing capital is the chapter that matters.
A mid-size bank that is systemic in one metro is still systemic. The spreadsheet should notice the metro.

perspectives.summary: A mixed cluster treats the app as both a democratized ticker and a casino that learned how to ping dopamine.
arguments: Zero commissions were paid for in order flow and attention. The price of the trade is the feed.
Meme common-sense sometimes finds a real squeeze. It also finds a lot of bags.
If the interface looks like a game, it will be played like one. That is not an accident.

perspectives.summary: Teachers describe take-home essays as a broken assessment once a chatbot can draft a B- in twelve seconds.
arguments: If the assignment can be completed without a mind in the room, it was already a weak assignment — the model just made that obvious.

Catching AI is an arms race that turns teachers into detectors instead of readers.

representative_posts.text: I miss the bad essays. At least they were theirs.

perspectives.summary: The optimistic cluster treats models as a 24-hour tutor for kids who never had one — if the school designs for it instead of pretending it is not there.
arguments: A patient explainer at 11pm is a public good for the kid whose parent works second shift.

Used as Socratic questions, it is a ladder. Used as a paragraph vending machine, it is a crutch.

representative_posts.text: The bot sat with my kid on fractions while I was on the floor. That is not cheating. That is the village we do not have.

representative_posts.text: I make them show the prompt. If the prompt is 'explain like I'm stuck on step 3', I am fine. If it is 'write the proof', I am not.

representative_posts.text: Translation plus worked examples is the first tutor some of my students have ever had. Ban it and you ban them.

perspectives.title: Extinctions
perspectives.summary: Field people talk about quiet losses — insects, mussels, a frog — that never make the charismatic-megafauna poster.
arguments: A collapse in insects is a collapse in everything that eats, pollinates, or decomposes. The owl is the press kit.
Triage is already happening. Pretending we can save every species is how we save the logo and lose the rest.
The rate is the story. A museum of what used to be here is not a policy.

representative_posts.author: windshield
representative_posts.text: I remember bugs. My kid thinks a clean windshield is normal. That is data.

representative_posts.author: triage
representative_posts.text: We cannot do 12,000 recovery plans. We can do habitats. Pick.

representative_posts.author: mussel

perspectives.title: Land Trusts
perspectives.summary: This view treats easements and local trusts as the actual conservation machine — slower than a tweet, stickier than a park bill.
arguments: A trust that pays a rancher to stay a rancher can beat a paper park that the next legislature sells.
Easements that lock injustice in place are not a win. Read who got paid to not develop.
If the land is conserved in a file cabinet, it is not conserved. Staff the stewards.

representative_posts.text: I used to know which landlord owned the complaints. Now we have a vibe and a TikTok.

representative_posts.author: unsupervised

perspectives.title: Overdose
perspectives.summary: This cluster is still the numbers: fentanyl in the supply, naloxone in the pocket, and a death that used to be a scare.
arguments: A supply that kills on the first mistake is not the crisis we trained for. The training has to move.
Naloxone is a floor, not a treatment plan. Floors still matter.
If the death is in a bathroom with no lock and no kit, design is the policy.

representative_posts.author: first-mistake
representative_posts.text: We used to get second chances. The powder ended that. Say it that way.

representative_posts.author: narcan-pocket
representative_posts.text: I carry it like keys. That is not a solution. It is a truce.

representative_posts.author: bathroom
representative_posts.text: Put a kit on the wall and stop locking people in to die politely.

perspectives.title: Treatment Beds
perspectives.summary: Families treat the waitlist as the actual statute: ready on Thursday, a bed in three weeks.
arguments: A person who asks for help on a weekday and waits is not noncompliant. The bed is.
If detox is a hallway and MAT is a maze, the 'treatment on demand' speech is a brand.
Cash facilities for the insured and a wait for everyone else is a caste system with a clinical smell.

representative_posts.author: thursday
representative_posts.text: He was willing on Thursday. The bed was in June. June did not get him.

representative_posts.author: mat-maze
representative_posts.text: The clinic is 90 minutes and a urine cup. That is not on demand. That is an obstacle course.

representative_posts.author: cash-bed
representative_posts.text: The nice place took a card. The public place took a number. Guess which census we count.

perspectives.title: Safe Supply
perspectives.summary: A smaller group wants a regulated alternative to a poisoned street — controversial, and they know it.
arguments: If the street is a roulette wheel, a clinic-grade option is harm reduction with a chemist, not a slogan.
Diversion risk is real. So is a death count that does not care about our discomfort.
Pilot it, measure it, publish it. Moral panic is not a trial design.

representative_posts.author: roulette
representative_posts.text: I would rather him on a weighed dose than a mystery stamp. Judge me after the funeral you do not have to attend.

representative_posts.author: divert
representative_posts.text: Yes, some will leak. Some already die. I can do both numbers.

representative_posts.author: pilot
representative_posts.text: Run the trial. If it fails, it fails in public. The street is already a trial with no IRB.

perspectives.title: Courts
perspectives.summary: Drug courts, mandatory treatment, and a prosecutor who is still the intake office.
arguments: A court cannot be the front door to medicine without becoming a worse hospital.
Coerced treatment that has no treatment attached is just a longer sentence.
If the charge is possession of a death-trap supply, the punishment will not unpoison the next bag.

representative_posts.author: front-door
representative_posts.text: He met a judge before he met a doctor. That sequence is the system.

representative_posts.author: coerced-empty
representative_posts.text: The order said treatment. The county said waitlist. The violation said jail.

representative_posts.author: next-bag
representative_posts.text: Lock the person. The stamp still wins. I would like a policy about the stamp.

perspectives.title: School Prayer
perspectives.summary: The old fight in a new costume: staff-led devotion, student clubs, and a board that wants a script.
arguments: A teacher with a captive room is not a student club. The captive is the constitutional fact.
If the board writes the prayer, it is a government speech. Stop calling it a vibe of the kids.
Equal access for student groups is the boring peace. A preferred script is the war.

representative_posts.author: captive
representative_posts.text: My kid cannot leave math. Do not put a devotion in math. Clubs are after the bell.

representative_posts.author: board-script
representative_posts.text: They drafted a prayer in a work session. That is not grassroots. That is a legislature.

representative_posts.author: equal-access
representative_posts.text: Let the kids meet. Do not pick the meeting. I can live with that truce.

perspectives.title: Tax Status
perspectives.summary: 501(c)(3) as a bargain: no electioneering, a pulpit, and a donation that is a public subsidy.
arguments: A deduction is a spend. If the pulpit is a PAC, the spend is a campaign finance story.
Houses that are mostly parking lots and political mail are testing the bargain on purpose.
Revoking is rare. Reporting is rarer. The bargain needs a cop or it is a story we tell.

representative_posts.author: the-spend
representative_posts.text: I deduct the gift. You do a slate. That is a public financing program.

representative_posts.author: parking-lot
representative_posts.text: The sanctuary is a room. The operation is a mailer. Audit the mailer.

representative_posts.author: a-cop
representative_posts.text: Nobody is the cop. So the bargain is a rumor. I would like a rumor with a form.

perspectives.title: Hospitals
perspectives.summary: Conscience clauses in the only ER for 80 miles — doctrine as a formulary.
arguments: A public that funds the building should know which care will not happen at 2am.
If the merger made the Catholic the only shop, the merger is the statute.
Clinicians who cannot follow a legal protocol because of a sponsor are practicing under two licenses.

representative_posts.author: 2am
representative_posts.text: The ER is a ministry and a monopoly. I found out in the hallway. Put it on the sign.

representative_posts.author: merger
representative_posts.text: They bought the secular one and kept the rule. That is how a doctrine becomes a county.

representative_posts.author: two-licenses
representative_posts.text: The state said I could. The sponsor said I could not. The patient heard the sponsor.

perspectives.title: Crop Insurance
perspectives.summary: Growers treat the policy as the real farm bill — a floor that also freezes bad habits in place.
arguments: A product that pays you to plant the same thing into a worse climate is not resilience. It is a habit subsidy.
Premiums that hide the risk from the operating loan will keep producing surprises in July.
If the actuarial table is political, the weather is still not.

representative_posts.author: same-crop
representative_posts.text: I insured corn again. The rain did not. That is the program.

representative_posts.author: july-surprise
representative_posts.text: The loss was certain in May. The check is a winter story. Cash is a summer story.

representative_posts.author: table
representative_posts.text: Do not 'improve' the table to make me plant into a desert. I can read a radar.

perspectives.title: Drought
perspectives.summary: This face is wells, fallow, and a feed bill that turns a cow into a liability.
arguments: A drought is a price in hay before it is a satellite image.
Selling the herd is a one-way door. The genetics do not come back with the rain.
Cities that buy the water and leave the dust are choosing a landscape.

representative_posts.author: hay-bill
representative_posts.text: The cows ate a truck of someone else's rain. That is drought accounting.

representative_posts.author: herd-sale
representative_posts.text: I sold the genetics my grandfather kept. The rain can return. That cannot.

representative_posts.author: buy-the-water
representative_posts.text: The suburb took the river. I took the dust. Very efficient allocation.

perspectives.title: Flood Years
perspectives.summary: The other tail: drowned fields, delayed planting, and a levee district that is a 1930s idea in a 2020s hydrograph.
arguments: Prevented planting is a real crop. It just does not photograph well.
Levees that protect last decade's development starve this decade's floodplain. That is a choice.
Tile and ditch that shunt water downstream faster are how a 'drainage success' becomes a neighbor's disaster.

representative_posts.author: prevented
representative_posts.text: I farmed a lake and a claim. The yield was a PDF.

representative_posts.author: levee-1936
representative_posts.text: The district is a museum. The hydrograph is not.

representative_posts.author: tile
representative_posts.text: We drained it in a day. The town downstream took our afternoon. That is hydrology, not luck.

perspectives.title: Co-ops
perspectives.summary: A hopeful cluster still treats the elevator, the rural electric, and the shared shop as the only scale a family farm can afford.
arguments: A co-op that remembers it is a member organization can bargain. A co-op that becomes a mini-Cargill cannot.
Shared equipment is climate adaptation: you cannot all own the $800k planter.
When the elevator is the only buyer, governance is the antitrust policy.

representative_posts.author: member
representative_posts.text: We voted out the CEO who thought we were a brand. We are a bin.

representative_posts.author: shared-planter
representative_posts.text: Three families, one machine, a calendar. That is the only way the math closes.

representative_posts.author: only-buyer
representative_posts.text: If they set the basis, they are a government. Elect them like one.

perspectives.title: MLS
perspectives.summary: The league as a real thing now: full buildings, a playoff that matters, and a ceiling still set by allocation money.
arguments: A designated player is a marketing plan. A wage structure that can keep a midfielder is a league.
If the calendar still fights the world, the product will keep feeling provincial.
Supporters' sections are the asset. Do not turn them into a hospitality SKU.

representative_posts.author: keep-the-6
representative_posts.text: We can sell a star. Can we keep the six? That is the boom test.

representative_posts.author: calendar
representative_posts.text: Play in the world's season or keep being a summer league with better food.

representative_posts.author: hospitality
representative_posts.text: The ultras built the building. The club built a cocktail. Watch which one they protect.

perspectives.title: Women's Game
perspectives.summary: This cluster is still facilities, travel, and a federation that discovered the team after the ratings.
arguments: Equal play on unequal fields is a press conference.
If the men's friendly gets the stadium and the women get a college soccer park, the boom is a guest.
Pay that arrived after a lawsuit is not generosity. It is a docket.

representative_posts.author: college-park
representative_posts.text: They sold out. They still got the high-school locker. Ratings are not keys.

representative_posts.author: friendly-split
representative_posts.text: He played in a cathedral. She played in a wind tunnel. Same federation.

representative_posts.author: docket
representative_posts.text: Do not thank them for the check. Thank the lawyers.

perspectives.title: World Cup
perspectives.summary: Hosts, human rights, and a month that makes casuals into theologians of the group stage.
arguments: A cup that washes a state is still a cup. It is also a wash. Hold both.
If the infrastructure is a promise to a neighborhood that will be gone in July, count the neighborhood.
Casual fandom is the point. Gatekeeping the group-stage tourist is how you stay small.

representative_posts.author: wash
representative_posts.text: I will watch. I will also read the labor report. Both are allowed in a living room.

representative_posts.author: gone-in-july
representative_posts.text: The pitch is pretty. The block that used to be there was also pretty. One remains.

representative_posts.author: tourist
representative_posts.text: Let people love a flag for a month. We can do tactics in club season.

perspectives.title: Local Clubs
perspectives.summary: The boom as a Tuesday night: amateur pitches, a second-division side, a pub that is the civic religion.
arguments: If MLS is the mall, the local club is the square. Starve the square and the mall is a fad.
Fields that are actually lit are a parks budget, not a vibe.
A supporter culture you cannot afford to enter is just another luxury box.

representative_posts.author: square
representative_posts.text: I go on Tuesday. The TV goes on Saturday. Tuesday is the boom I trust.

representative_posts.author: lit-fields
representative_posts.text: Put lights on the county pitch. The academy can wait.

representative_posts.author: luxury-ultra
representative_posts.text: If the scarf requires a membership I cannot pay, it is merch, not a culture.

perspectives.title: Rate Brackets
perspectives.summary: The loud argument is still the top rate versus the next deduction — a morality play that ignores what actually gets filed.
arguments: A headline rate that nobody with a good accountant pays is a brand, not a base.
Brackets that do not move with housing costs are a stealth increase on work in expensive metros.
If the fight is only the top number, the rest of the return gets looted in peace.

representative_posts.author: headline
representative_posts.text: They argued 37 versus 39. My effective is 19 with a better firm. Cute play.

representative_posts.author: cola-housing
representative_posts.text: The bracket did not notice the rent. That is a raise for the Treasury, not for me.

representative_posts.author: top-number
representative_posts.text: Keep the camera on the rate. The footnote is where the money lives.

perspectives.title: Loopholes
perspectives.summary: This cluster wants the code read as a map of who has a lobbyist: pass-through games, carried interest, and credits that never sunset.
arguments: A preference that survives every 'reform' is not a glitch. It is the point of the coalition.
Credits stacked until a profitable firm pays a thank-you note are why people think the system is fake.
Sunset clauses that never sunset are how a temporary idea becomes a family office.

representative_posts.author: passthrough
representative_posts.text: Wages are wages until they are a partnership. Then they are a costume.

representative_posts.author: carry
representative_posts.text: I get it. Risk. I also get a W-2. Harmonize those without a seminar.

representative_posts.author: never-sunset
representative_posts.text: The credit was for 2009. It is a personality now.

perspectives.title: Local Levies
perspectives.summary: Property-tax revolts treat the school millage as the only tax people can see — and the only one they can punch.
arguments: When the visible tax is the house, every city service becomes a war on people who stayed.
Caps that starve the school and inflate the sale price are a gift to the already-housed.
If you want less property tax, you need another base. Rage at the envelope is not a base.

representative_posts.author: envelope
representative_posts.text: The only bill with my name on it is the millage. Of course I hate it. That is the design.

representative_posts.author: cap-stay

representative_posts.author: other-base
representative_posts.text: Find income or sales and then we can talk. Until then the house is the piñata.

perspectives.title: Wealth Taxes
perspectives.summary: A smaller group wants a mark-to-market or a net-worth levy; opponents call valuation a hall of mirrors.
arguments: Unrealized gains that fund a lifestyle are income in every sense except the one the code chose.
Valuation of private assets is a fight. So is a world where wage earners prepay and founders never sell.
If the administrative mess is the knockout, propose the cleaner cousin: better estate and realization rules. Do not pretend the mess is the morality.

representative_posts.author: estate-cousin

perspectives.title: Gene Editing
perspectives.summary: This cluster treats CRISPR as a manufacturing method now — powerful, cheapening, and racing ahead of the clinic's ethics board.
arguments: A tool that can rewrite a germline is not 'just biology'. It is an industrial process with inheritance attached.
Somatic therapies that work will create a politics of who can afford a one-time edit.
Ban theater at the border will not stop a well-funded lab. Publish the rules where the work actually happens.

representative_posts.text: The protocol is on a wiki and the enzyme is in the catalog. The bottleneck is courage, not equipment.

representative_posts.text: A one-and-done cure that costs a mortgage is a miracle with a prior auth.

representative_posts.author: summit-ban

perspectives.title: Lab Access
perspectives.summary: Tinkerers and biosecurity people fight over garage labs: the same openness that spreads diagnostics can spread mistakes.
arguments: Democratized protocols without democratized waste handling is how you get a clever accident.
Gatekeeping reagents can slow a fool. It also slows the clinic in a town the company does not care about.
The right control is audited training and culture, not a romance about who is allowed to own a pipette.

representative_posts.author: garage-pcr
representative_posts.text: We ran wastewater tests in a warehouse and beat the official dashboard by a week. Access is a public good.

representative_posts.author: select-agent
representative_posts.text: The interesting risk is not a movie virus. It is a competent person having a bad year.

representative_posts.author: mail-order
representative_posts.text: If the kit ships, the policy shipped. Pretending otherwise is a vibe.

perspectives.title: Patent Thickets
perspectives.summary: Researchers describe stacked claims as the reason a test or a therapy dies in a lawyer's inbox, not in a trial.
arguments: A diagnostic that requires three licenses is not innovation. It is a toll booth with a journal citation.
University tech-transfer offices that sit on tools are not stewards. They are landlords of a grant.
Compulsory licensing talk shows up when a pandemic makes the thicket visible. The thicket was always there.

representative_posts.author: freedom-op
representative_posts.text: We designed around three patents and into a fourth. The molecule was the easy part.

representative_posts.author: tlo-shelf
representative_posts.text: The campus owns a CRISPR tweak nobody can sublicense. That is a trophy, not a therapy.

representative_posts.author: test-toll
representative_posts.text: The assay would cost $8 in reagents and $200 in letters. Guess which price the patient sees.

perspectives.title: Clinic Ethics
perspectives.summary: Clinicians want consent, equity, and off-label hype treated as the actual bottleneck once the tool works on paper.
arguments: A trial that only enrolls the already-insured will write a future that looks like the present, only more expensive.
Informed consent is a process, not a PDF, especially when the edit is irreversible.
Influencer clinics selling unproven infusions are the gray market the journal articles pretend not to see.

representative_posts.author: consent-hour
representative_posts.text: We spent more time on the form than on the science. That is not bureaucracy. That is the medicine.

representative_posts.author: enroll-gap
representative_posts.text: The trial is 'open'. The travel stipend is not. Diversity died in the parking garage.

representative_posts.author: infusion-ad
representative_posts.text: A clinic in a mall is selling youth. The FDA letter will arrive after the invoices.

perspectives.title: Transit
perspectives.summary: Riders describe paratransit windows, broken elevators, and a bus that kneels in theory.
arguments: A 4-hour pickup window is not transit. It is house arrest with a van.
Elevators out of service with no date are how a system announces who may travel.
If the app cannot book a wheelchair space, the app is the barrier.

representative_posts.text: They gave me 7 to 11. My appointment is at 8. That is not a ride. That is a shrug.

representative_posts.author: elevator
representative_posts.text: Three stations, three outages, one city that loves a press release about inclusion.

representative_posts.author: app-space
representative_posts.text: I can tap pay. I cannot tap a space that exists. Fix the software or admit the fleet.

perspectives.title: Workplaces
perspectives.summary: This cluster wants accommodations that are not a negotiation with a stranger in HR who has a mood.
arguments: A process that takes three months is a no that learned to speak politely.
Remote as an accommodation vanished when the badge policy returned. That was a tell.
If the job can be done with a screen reader, the PDF that cannot is the violation.

representative_posts.text: The job ended before the chair arrived. Very agile.

representative_posts.author: badge-back
representative_posts.text: They discovered my disability the day they discovered the office. I noticed.

representative_posts.text: The application was a picture of text. That is not a portal. That is a locked door.

perspectives.title: Benefits Cliffs
perspectives.summary: People on SSI/SSDI treat a raise, a marriage, or a savings account as a trap the brochure calls an incentive.
arguments: A $1 job that costs $4 in benefits is not a ladder. It is a punishment for trying.
Asset limits from another century are how you keep people poor on purpose.
If work is the goal, the phase-out has to look like a ramp, not a cliff you need a lawyer to see.

representative_posts.text: I got hours. I lost the aide. The hours cannot replace the aide. Do the math they will not print.

representative_posts.author: asset-1980
representative_posts.text: I cannot save for a tire. That is not fraud prevention. That is a cage.

representative_posts.author: ramp
representative_posts.text: Draw me a phase-out a human can ride. I can work. I cannot teleport.

perspectives.title: Devices
perspectives.summary: Wheelchairs, hearing aids, and DME as a prior-auth novel — equipment that is medicine and is treated as a luxury SKU.
arguments: A chair that takes 11 months is a sentence to the bed.
Hearing aids on a consumer price tag while glasses sit in a drugstore is a caste of the senses.
Repair rights for a wheelchair should not be rarer than repair rights for a tractor.

representative_posts.author: 11-months
representative_posts.text: I grew around a broken frame waiting for a 'custom' that is a catalog. Time is the denial.

representative_posts.author: hearing-sku
representative_posts.text: My ears are retail. My neighbor's lenses are a kiosk. Explain it without the word lifestyle.

representative_posts.author: right-to-fix
representative_posts.text: The vendor has the key. My mechanic does not. I am not a printer.

perspectives.title: Packaging
perspectives.summary: Shoppers meet the crisis as clamshells, chips bags, and a cucumber in armor.
arguments: If the product needs a second product to be held, the first product is overbuilt.
Producer responsibility that is a fee into a black box is not design. It is an indulgence.
Refill only scales if the store is built for it. A tote in a walk-in pantry is not a system.

representative_posts.author: cucumber
representative_posts.text: The cucumber had a jacket. I did not ask for a jacket. The jacket will outlive me.

representative_posts.author: epr-box
representative_posts.text: They paid a fee and kept the clamshell. That is not responsibility. That is postage.

representative_posts.author: refill-aisle
representative_posts.text: Put the bulk bins where the chips were. Then we can talk about my tote.

perspectives.title: Recycling Myths
perspectives.summary: This cluster is done with the chasing-arrows lie: most of it was always a thermal or a landfill story.
arguments: A symbol that means 'please feel fine' is marketing, not a material science.
If China is not taking the bale, the bale was never a commodity. It was an export of confusion.
Stop printing recyclable on a film that has never had a market. That is a fraud with a logo.

representative_posts.author: arrow-lie
representative_posts.text: I rinsed it for 20 years. Then I read the bale price. I was the product.

representative_posts.author: bale-port
representative_posts.text: When the shipping stopped, the 'recycling' stopped. Honesty would have been cheaper.

representative_posts.author: film
representative_posts.text: The bag says store drop-off. The store has a locked bin. Cute.

perspectives.title: Drills
perspectives.summary: Parents and teachers argue that lockdown drills have become the default safety policy even when they scare kids more than they prevent harm.
arguments: A drill that looks like the real event trains children to expect violence without teaching them how to stay safe.
Time spent on ALICE days is time not spent on counselors, locked vestibules, or threat assessment.
Kids who already live with that fear should not have to rehearse it on a school-day calendar.

representative_posts.author: lockdown-mom
representative_posts.text: We had three lockdown drills this month. My third-grader now asks if today is the day someone comes.

representative_posts.author: alicesub
representative_posts.text: If the plan is practice dying, we do not have a safety plan. We have a ritual with a substitute teacher.

representative_posts.author: grade3-desk
representative_posts.text: Counselors are part-time. The ALICE trainer is a full-day sub. That budget is a worldview.

perspectives.title: Counselors
perspectives.summary: This cluster says the real safety intervention is mental-health staffing, not another hardware grant.
arguments: Most campus crises start as a student in distress that a 700-to-1 counselor ratio cannot possibly catch.
A metal detector does not sit with a kid who posted a goodbye. A person does.
Until every campus has a full-time counselor and a threat-assessment team, drills are theater around an empty office.

representative_posts.author: caseload700
representative_posts.text: I have 700 students and a closet. You cannot threat-assess a spreadsheet.

representative_posts.author: psych-wait
representative_posts.text: The district bought a camera system the same week they froze the counselor hire. Priorities are a purchase order.

representative_posts.author: parent-iep
representative_posts.text: My kid asked for help in October. The intake is March. Safety is a waitlist with a lock on the classroom door.

perspectives.title: Design
perspectives.summary: Facilities people treat school safety as a building problem: sightlines, vestibules, and rooms that actually lock.
arguments: A classroom that cannot lock from the inside is a policy failure hiding in a floor plan.
Single-point entries and interior windows beat a motivational poster about 'see something'.
Portables, open campuses, and 1970s courtyards set more risk than any curriculum fight.

representative_posts.author: facilities-am
representative_posts.text: We still have classrooms that do not lock from the inside. That is not a training gap.

representative_posts.author: vestibule
representative_posts.text: The bond paid for a scoreboard. The main office still opens onto a hallway with no second door.

representative_posts.author: portable-row
representative_posts.text: Half the school is in portables with a padlock aesthetic. Hardening a trailer is a punchline.

perspectives.title: Police
perspectives.summary: A smaller cluster wants armed officers and faster tactical response treated as the actual last line, not a culture-war prop.
arguments: A counselor cannot stop an active attacker who is already in the building; someone with a radio and a weapon might.
Response time is the variable parents actually live with after the cameras fail.
SRO programs are uneven, but removing them without a replacement is not a safety plan either.

representative_posts.author: sro-desk
representative_posts.text: I am not a hallway cop cartoon. I am the person who knows which kid has been spiraling since October.

representative_posts.author: wait-time

representative_posts.author: after-action
representative_posts.text: We can argue about police in schools after the door locks and the counselor exists. Until then it is not either-or.

perspectives.title: Password Rules
perspectives.summary: Households treat the crackdown as a raise: the shared account was the product, then it was a crime.
arguments: A price that assumed four houses was the price. Changing the assumption is a hike.
If the interface still begs me to share until it bills me for sharing, the copywriters should meet the lawyers.
People will pirate a feeling of being punished. That is not a moral tale. It is UX.

representative_posts.author: four-houses
representative_posts.text: Mom had the login. That was the plan in 2019. The plan got a fee.

perspectives.title: Show Cancellations
perspectives.summary: Fans describe three-season graves: tax write-offs, vanishing finales, and a library that is a trapdoor.
arguments: A show that cannot close a story is a product that used the audience as a test balloon.
Removing a title you already sold in a bundle is a special kind of bait.
If the incentive is a write-off, do not ask for loyalty. Ask an accountant.

representative_posts.author: season-3
representative_posts.text: They asked me to care and then deleted the ending. I can also delete the app.

representative_posts.author: trapdoor
representative_posts.text: It was in my list on Tuesday. Wednesday it was a tax event.

representative_posts.text: Stop the 'thank you for being on this journey' email. The journey was a spreadsheet.

perspectives.title: Discovery
perspectives.summary: The home screen as a junk drawer: 40 thumbnails, none of them the thing you heard about.
arguments: A catalog you cannot search is a warehouse with a slot machine at the door.
