representative_posts.author: bread
representative_posts.text: It is still food. It is also a monument to a gap. I can hold a can and a complaint.

perspectives.title: Disaster
perspectives.summary: The van that arrives before FEMA: chainsaws, a kitchen, a chaplain who also has a generator.
arguments: Mutual aid that beats the org chart is a compliment and an indictment.
If the only bilingual team is the church, the county has a language policy problem.
Clergy who do logistics should be in the EOC, not as mascots, as operators.

representative_posts.author: chainsaw
representative_posts.text: We had fuel. They had a presser. Fuel won Tuesday.

representative_posts.author: bilingual
representative_posts.text: Our youth group did intake in two languages. The county had a form in one. Fix the form.

representative_posts.author: eoc
representative_posts.text: Put us in the room. We already have the list of who has a generator.

perspectives.title: Volunteers
perspectives.summary: The same retired people, a youth group, a liability form — the labor model of a thousand 501(c)(3)s.
arguments: A model that depends on a 70-year-old's back is a clock.
Youth missions that are a photo are not a labor force. They are a brochure.
If you want reliability, mix the rota with a wage. Holiness will not cover Thursday forever.

representative_posts.author: clock
representative_posts.text: Our best volunteer is 74. That is a miracle and a warning.

representative_posts.author: photo
representative_posts.text: They came for a reel. We needed a driver in February. Hire a driver.

representative_posts.author: thursday
representative_posts.text: Pay one coordinator. I will keep the miracle. I will not pretend the miracle is a plan.

perspectives.title: Host Costs
perspectives.summary: Cities treat the Games as a hangover: stadiums that do not convert, a debt that does, and a bid that was a vanity.
arguments: A temporary sport with a permanent ruin is the usual souvenir.
If the bid process is a sales department, the city is the mark.
Reuse, cap, and a no-new-venues rule are the only grown-up bids left.

representative_posts.author: ruin
representative_posts.text: The velodrome is a puddle. The bond is not. That is a Game.

representative_posts.author: mark
representative_posts.text: They sold us a mood. We bought a millage. I would like a receipt that is not a flag.

representative_posts.author: no-new
representative_posts.text: Use the college. Use the road. If it needs a spaceship, it is a no.

perspectives.title: Boycotts
perspectives.summary: Athletes as diplomats they did not vote for — and a history of boycotts that punished the wrong body.
arguments: A boycott that sits the 22-year-old and not the federation is a morality play with a casualty.
If the point is the host's law, say the law. A vibe about 'the Olympics' is how you get a press hit and a ruined cycle.
Competing and speaking is also a politics. Pretending the start list is neutrality is a myth.

representative_posts.author: wrong-body
representative_posts.text: I lost my one Games. The minister did not. Remember the body.

representative_posts.author: say-the-law
representative_posts.text: Name the statute. Then I can decide if my start is a collaboration.

representative_posts.author: start-list
representative_posts.text: I can run and still have a mouth. The committee hates that combo.

perspectives.title: Athletes
perspectives.summary: The people in the village: funding, a 4-year wage, and a committee that owns the image.
arguments: A gold that still needs a GoFundMe is a scandal, not a human-interest piece.
If Rule 40 is a muzzle on the only month they can eat, the brand is the parasite.
Mental health as a press value and a cut in the stipend is a contradiction the village can see.

representative_posts.author: gofundme
representative_posts.text: She won. She still had a link in bio. That is the model.

representative_posts.author: rule-40
representative_posts.text: They own my face in August. August is the only month the face is worth anything.

representative_posts.author: stipend-cut
representative_posts.text: They posted a hotline and trimmed the check. I used neither.

perspectives.title: Broadcast
perspectives.summary: Tape delay in a live world, a rights fee that hides sports, and a prime-time that is a reality show with medals.
arguments: If the event is over on my phone, the tape is an insult, not a package.
A rights holder that buries a sport to save a narrative is a producer, not a public square.
Streaming that still needs a cable login is the hangover of the last monopoly.

representative_posts.author: phone-first
representative_posts.text: I knew the result at lunch. They packaged the surprise at 8. I am not 1998.

representative_posts.author: buried
representative_posts.text: The final was on a channel I do not have. The talk show was on the one I do.

representative_posts.author: login
representative_posts.text: I paid for the Games. I also paid for a bundle I do not want. Very modern.

perspectives.title: VAR
perspectives.summary: The screen as a second referee: longer waits, a still that lies, and a crowd that now boos a pixel.
arguments: A tool that cannot admit uncertainty will freeze a bad still and call it justice.
If the standard is 'clear and obvious', stop using a microscope. Microscopes are not obvious.
Audio that the crowd cannot hear is a private trial in a public house.

representative_posts.author: bad-still
representative_posts.text: They picked the frame that fit the story. The next frame did not. I have eyes.

representative_posts.author: microscope
representative_posts.text: Clear and obvious took four minutes. That is a seminar, not a match.

representative_posts.author: private-trial
representative_posts.text: Let us hear it or stop pretending we are in the room.

perspectives.title: Abuse
perspectives.summary: Refs as a shortage: youth who will not sign up because a parent is a weather system.
arguments: A sideline that screams at a 16-year-old official is how you get no officials.
If the pro game models contempt, the rec game will copy it without the paycheck.
A camera on the parent is a sad solution and also the one that works.

representative_posts.author: 16-year-old
representative_posts.text: She quit. He is a dentist. The dentist won. The Saturday league lost.

representative_posts.author: model
representative_posts.text: They screamed at the VAR and then asked where the youth refs went. Geography.

representative_posts.author: camera-parent
representative_posts.text: Film the stands. Shame is a tool. I would like a tool.

perspectives.title: Unbelief
perspectives.summary: Atheism, agnosticism, and a public life that no longer needs a chaplain to open the meeting.
arguments: A city that can start a meeting without a prayer is not hostile. It is plural.
If unbelief is treated as a hole to be filled, the filling will feel like a sale.
Moral language without a sky is already how most people argue. Notice it.

representative_posts.author: no-chaplain
representative_posts.text: We had a quorum and a clock. We did not need a guest deity. The vote still counted.

representative_posts.author: a-sale
representative_posts.text: They keep offering me a hole. I have a life. The life is the point.

representative_posts.author: already
representative_posts.text: We already say ought without a citation. The citation was optional. I opted out.

perspectives.title: Ritual Lite
perspectives.summary: Sunday assemblies without a creed: humanist halls, solstice, a funeral that is still a funeral.
arguments: People still need a script for death and a baby. The market will provide a script. Ask who writes it.
A ritual that is only an aesthetic will lose to one that can hold a body.
Borrowing the music and skipping the metaphysics is allowed. It is also unstable. Be honest about the borrow.

representative_posts.author: the-script
representative_posts.text: We needed words at the grave. The off-the-shelf ones were fine. I still want better writers.

representative_posts.author: hold-a-body
representative_posts.text: Candles are pretty. A community that brings casseroles is the ritual.

representative_posts.author: borrow
representative_posts.text: We sang their song. We did not pay their tithe. I can live with the debt if we name it.

perspectives.title: Politics
perspectives.summary: Nones as a bloc that does not act like a bloc — and a party that is unsure whether to court or fear them.
arguments: A secular vote that only exists as 'not that' will be rented by whoever is not that this year.
If the left treats churches as a museum of the enemy, it will miss the mutual-aid ones.
Public reason is a discipline. Mocking it as cringe is how you get a politics of vibes.

representative_posts.author: rented
representative_posts.text: I voted against a slate, not for a catechism. Do not baptize me in the victory speech.

representative_posts.author: mutual-aid
representative_posts.text: The church van still shows up. The meme does not. I can hold that without converting.

representative_posts.author: cringe
representative_posts.text: Give me a reason that works on a stranger. The inside joke is not a coalition.

perspectives.title: Community
perspectives.summary: The hole after leaving: friends, childcare, a Tuesday, a death — the unglamorous utilities of a congregation.
arguments: If your secular life cannot find a casserole, you did not replace the church. You replaced the sermon.
Third places that are not a bar are the actual religious-freedom issue for the unaffiliated.
Parenting without a parish is logistics. Build the logistics or stop wondering why people go back.

representative_posts.author: casserole
representative_posts.text: When he died, the group chat sent hearts. The parish would have sent a dish. I noticed.

representative_posts.author: not-a-bar
representative_posts.text: I would like a Tuesday that is not alcohol. Libraries almost count. Fund more almosts.

representative_posts.author: logistics
representative_posts.text: I went back for the nursery, not the creed. That is an indictment of the rest of us.

perspectives.title: Primary Voters
perspectives.summary: A bloc that still decides a Tuesday in some states — pastors, a text list, a candidate in the foyer.
arguments: A foyer that is a precinct is legal. It is also a party. Put the disclaimer where the coffee is.
If the bloc can punish a heresy faster than a legislature, the heresy is the whip.
Turnout operations that are 'just church' are why people who are not in the church feel like a minority in a majority county.

representative_posts.author: coffee
representative_posts.text: The sample ballot was next to the donuts. I can read a precinct when I see one.

representative_posts.author: whip
representative_posts.text: They moved faster than the party. The party noticed. So did I.

representative_posts.author: minority-feel
representative_posts.text: I live here. I do not go there. On Tuesday it feels like their house. That is data.

perspectives.title: Media
perspectives.summary: A parallel news: radio, a network, a phone that never shows the other graph.
arguments: A media that cannot survive a contrary fact will eventually try to survive by calling the fact a persecution.
If the only journalists in the coalition are advocates, the coalition will not see the crash coming.
Crossover that is only a hostage video of a 'liberal' is not information. It is a rite.

representative_posts.author: persecution
representative_posts.text: The number was the number. They called it a plot. I kept the number.

representative_posts.author: crash
representative_posts.text: Nobody in the feed does courts. Then the court arrived. Surprise is expensive.

representative_posts.author: rite
representative_posts.text: I watched a ritual of dunking. I did not watch a story. Name it a ritual.

perspectives.title: Young Exit
perspectives.summary: The quiet leaving: not always deconstruction-as-content, sometimes a job, a gay cousin, a tiredness.
arguments: A politics that needs the young and scolds the young will get neither.
If the only story of leaving is a traitor narrative, you will not hear why they left.
Exvangelical as a brand is real. So is a kid who just wanted a church that could lose a race without a prophecy.

representative_posts.author: scold
representative_posts.text: They wanted my vote and my silence. I kept the vote to myself.

representative_posts.author: traitor
representative_posts.text: Ask me why. Do not start with a demon. I left because of a cousin and a vote.

representative_posts.author: lose-a-race
representative_posts.text: I wanted a sermon that could survive November. We got a weather report. I changed rooms.

perspectives.title: Policy
perspectives.summary: The actual asks: judges, schools, a rule about bodies — a program, not a vibe.
arguments: A movement that cannot name a health-care plan but can name a court is a judicial project. Describe it that way.
Schools are the domestic policy. Everything else is a poster.
If the program requires a state small enough to drown except where it touches a classroom, that is not small. It is selective.

representative_posts.author: judicial-project
representative_posts.text: Tell me the clinic plan. You told me the judge. I wrote that down.

representative_posts.author: classroom
representative_posts.text: The bill is always the school. The rest is a parade.

representative_posts.author: selective
representative_posts.text: Drown it except the principal's office. That is a big state in a costume.

perspectives.title: Livestreams
perspectives.summary: The sanctuary as a camera: a gift for the homebound and a habit for the rest.
arguments: A stream that replaces the room will eventually replace the pledge, the casserole, and the argument.
If the homebound are the reason, design for them — captions, a call, a person who notices an empty square.
Multi-site churches that are a brand with a lens already made this choice. The rest are sliding into it.

representative_posts.author: replace
representative_posts.text: We kept the stream after we could go back. The room got polite and thin.

representative_posts.author: square
representative_posts.text: Caption it. Call the person who always watched and then did not. That is pastoral care.

representative_posts.author: brand-lens
representative_posts.text: The pastor is a thumbnail. I miss a person who knows my kid's name.

perspectives.title: Apps
perspectives.summary: Prayer as a streak: notifications, a paywall on a psalm, a community that is a server.
arguments: A streak is a slot machine. Holiness that needs a streak will take the slot's ethics.
If the psalm is behind a subscription, you have made a utility into a SaaS.
Push notifications at 6am are a discipline some people want. They are also a product.

representative_posts.author: streak
representative_posts.text: I prayed because the flame would die. That is not what I meant by daily.

representative_posts.author: saas-psalm
representative_posts.text: The text is older than the store. Charge me for the community, not the text.

representative_posts.author: 6am
representative_posts.text: The bell is fine. The upsell after the bell is why I deleted it.

perspectives.title: Grief
perspectives.summary: Funerals on a laptop, a guest book that is a comments field, a death that will not sit still on a feed.
arguments: A stream of a funeral is a mercy for the cousin who cannot fly. It is a theft if it becomes content.
Comments under a death are a new etiquette we are bad at. Write a rule.
If the only shiva is a group chat, someone still has to bring the real dish. The chat will not.

representative_posts.author: mercy-theft
representative_posts.text: Aunt Jane saw it. A stranger also did. One of those was the point.

representative_posts.author: etiquette
representative_posts.text: Do not like a death. Do not ratio a widow. We need a book of manners for this site.

representative_posts.author: real-dish
representative_posts.text: The chat was kind. The lasagna still had to exist. I drove the lasagna.

perspectives.title: Attention
perspectives.summary: The feed as a rival liturgy: hour for hour, a Sabbath that has to be a setting.
arguments: A practice that cannot survive a phone in the pew already lost to a better ritual designer.
Sabbath as airplane mode is a joke that is also a rule. Keep the rule.
If the sermon has to compete with a clip, shorten the sermon or improve the silence. Do not just add lights.

representative_posts.author: better-designer
representative_posts.text: They have a thousand engineers. We have a bulletin. I know who is winning the hour.

representative_posts.author: airplane
representative_posts.text: On Saturday the phone dies in a bowl. That is the most religious thing I do.

representative_posts.author: silence
representative_posts.text: Do not add a screen. Subtract a noise. I came for a room that does not ping.

perspectives.title: Burial Sites
perspectives.summary: Bones, a survey, a project that discovered a cemetery in a trench.
arguments: A site that is a cemetery is not a surprise if you asked the people who bury.
If the law requires a halt, the halt is the point. Speed is the vandalism.
Reburial that is a ceremony and not a PR is the only adult ending.

representative_posts.author: asked
representative_posts.text: We told them in the hearing. They found us in the trench. Listening is cheaper.

representative_posts.author: halt
representative_posts.text: Stop the machine. The schedule is not a sacrament.

representative_posts.author: not-pr
representative_posts.text: Bring the families. Leave the cameras. Do the work.

perspectives.title: Pipelines
perspectives.summary: Routes, easements, water, a prayer that is also a blockade.
arguments: A route that only gets easy when it is on someone else's treaty is not engineering. It is a map of power.
Consultation after the PEA is a courtesy. Consent is a veto they do not want to write.
Water as a relative is a legal theory in some places and a metaphor in others. Know which jurisdiction you are in.

representative_posts.author: treaty-easy
representative_posts.text: The other side of the river was harder. Wonder why.

representative_posts.author: courtesy
representative_posts.text: They mailed us the plan. The plan had a start date. That is not a question.

representative_posts.author: jurisdiction
representative_posts.text: Here the water is a person. Your metaphor can wait in the truck.

perspectives.title: Parks
perspectives.summary: Public land that is also a shrine: climbing bans, a solstice, a ranger in the middle.
arguments: A park that cannot hold a closed day for a ceremony is a recreation product, not a commons with a memory.
If climbers and a nation both love a rock, the law has to rank. Pretending it will not rank is how you get a surprise closure.
Rangers as cops of the sacred is a job nobody trained them for. Write the protocol.

representative_posts.author: closed-day
representative_posts.text: Give the morning to the people who named it. The afternoon can be a postcard.

representative_posts.author: rank
representative_posts.text: Say the ranking in the plan. I can hate it in daylight.

representative_posts.author: protocol
representative_posts.text: Do not make a GS-7 invent a theology at a trailhead. Send a letter.

perspectives.title: Repatriation
perspectives.summary: Museums, NAGPRA, a drawer of remains that was a collection and is a relative.
arguments: A catalog number is not a name. The work is the name.
If the museum's identity requires the drawer, the identity is the problem.
Speed without care is a second taking. Care without speed is a stall. Staff both.

representative_posts.author: the-name
representative_posts.text: Give them back with a name if you have it. The number can stay in your shame file.

representative_posts.author: identity
representative_posts.text: We can be a museum without a basement of people. Try. It is allowed.

representative_posts.author: staff-both
representative_posts.text: Hire the team. Date the boxes. Do not make a nation wait on an intern year.
